extracted text: The age-hardening aluminium alloy Al 2024 was received as an extrusion (Ø 63 mm, extrusion ratio ER = 15). Specimen blanks were solution heat treated at 495°C for 1 h followed by water-quenching. Part of the blanks was naturally aged for at least 5 days at room temperature (condition T4). Another part was artificially aged at 190°C for 12 h (condition T6).
property mapping:
σy - Yield strength in MPa
UTS - Ultimate tensile strength in MPa
El - Elongation percentage
εF - Fracture strain
HV10 - Vickers hardness with 10 kg load
abbreviations:
T4 - Solution heat treated at 495°C for 1 h, water-quenched, and naturally aged for at least 5 days at room temperature
T6 - Solution heat treated at 495°C for 1 h, water-quenched, and artificially aged at 190°C for 12 h
